key_insight: NH4SCN promotes high-n quasi-2D scaffold phases that template highly (110)-ordered 3D MAPbI3, rather than primarily enabling charge transport through vertically oriented 2D layers.
engineering_relevance: Controlling crystallisation kinetics and lattice matching offers a route to improve perovskite film structure for solar cells.
method: Use spectroscopic and structural studies to probe NH4SCN-mediated crystallisation.
Extend the nucleation window to suppress n = 1 phases and promote high-n quasi-2D scaffolds.
Assess lattice matching and cation dependence of quasi-2D-to-3D templating.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports structural evidence of highly (110)-ordered MAPbI3 and close lattice matching with quasi-2D phases, but gives no quantitative device-performance results.
watch_item: The templating mechanism is cation dependent and requires both compatible lattice matching and effective kinetic control.
paper_title: Ammonium thiocyanate enables in-situ structural templating of MAPbI3 via quasi-2D perovskite scaffold
